evidencePassages.text: No discrepancy has been identified between the purchase price in the contract and the price reported to the lender.

detail: The lender disclosure note records that the purchase price reported to Example Building Society is £875,000 and that no discrepancy has been identified against the contract price.
reference: Acting for Lenders and Prevention and Detection of Mortgage Fraud, Section 8(ii)

source.text: No discrepancy has been identified between the purchase price in the contract and the price reported to the lender.

title: Purchase Price Consistency Is Recorded for Lender Disclosure
